messages:
Anika: Hey team — FinCloud POC hitting intermittent 429s during large embedding import. Demo is tomorrow morning, can we triage?
Devon: What route + model + pattern are they using? parallel clients, batch size, tokens per doc?
Anika: Route is /v1/embeddings model=rw1-large. They fire ~100 parallel connections, each uploads 10 docs, avg ~2k tokens/doc. No retries configured.
Sara: That screams per-route cap + burst exhaustion. Can you paste one of the 429 responses (headers)?
Anika: Posted headers from a failing request:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
X-RW-Global-Limit: 1200/min
X-RW-Global-Remaining: 3
X-RW-Route-Limit: 30/s
X-RW-Route-Remaining: 0
X-RW-Route-WindowSec: 60
X-RW-Token-Budget-Remaining: 45000
```
Devon: Interesting — global budget still has some tokens but route limit is 30/s so 100 concurrent will overflow quickly. Also token budget looks fine but the per-route QPS is the blocker.
Mike: Two quick paths: 1) short-lived reservation bump for the embeddings route for the demo window (1-4h), 2) immediate client mitigation: reduce concurrency to ~20 and add exponential backoff + jitter. Which do we want?
Anika: Sales asked if a temporary bump is possible (they don't want to re-architect before demo). Also want a note on pricing impact for a bump.
Devon: Temporary reservation is possible. For pricing, small hourly bump -> minimal cost, but if they go reserved capacity long-term recommend Dedicated (committed). I'll DM the finance calc.
Sara: I'll prep a safe config change: increase X-RW-Route-Limit for org fincloud-001 from 30/s to 120/s for 3 hours. That should absorb the burst without touching global. Also enable short Retry-After hint adjustment so clients backoff nicely.
Mike: I'll raise the reservation in the quota service: ticket #Q-9482, ETA 10m. Also adding an audit note for security/Q.
ops-bot: quota-service: applied patch -> route_limit(fincloud-001,/v1/embeddings)=120/s (expires in 3h). AuditID=aud-2026-4571.
Anika: Thanks — deploying client change now to add retries and cap concurrency as precaution.
Devon: For post-demo follow-up we should send the customer recommended client patterns: batching, collapsing duplicate items, and enabling adaptive concurrency. Also offer a short runbook for integrating library retries.
Sara: Agreed. I'll also open a follow-up CR to evaluate whether this route should have a higher default per-route budget for embedding-heavy tenants.
Mike: Ticket updated with pricing note and next steps.
Anika: Demo finished — no 429s after the temporary bump, customer happy. Closing out. :rocket:
